final: SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) as track_count, CAST(COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(pt2.TrackId) as track_count FROM Playlist p2 LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt2 ON p2.PlaylistId = pt2.PlaylistId GROUP BY p2.PlaylistId)) as ratio FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
